title: API Strategy, Multi-Protocol Adapters & Contract Versioning
description: The @nestjs-yalc/api-strategy package enforces standardized API design paradigms across REST, GraphQL, and Messaging protocols. It provides multi-protocol controller abstractions, automated URI versioning strategies, uniform response payload wrapping, and content-negotiation adapters.
